entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can channel magical power through your weapon to devastating effect.

Prerequisite(s): Arcing Weapon, diverse training class feature.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can cast a spell with an area of effect and a duration of instantaneous, such as fireball, and release it through your melee weapon as part of a melee attack. This functions as the magus spellstrike ability, except the spell damage does not multiply on a critical hit, the spell effect is centered on you, and you are excluded from its effects.
